g.text: The old sequencer seals at T, then only answers strays
The old standby runs the same machine as a follower and takes over the seal if the primary fails early.
both answer strays, every packet within 1 µs:
1 lane stop first rx_ts ≥ T seals the lane
2 final cut C_f holds every lane's last op
3 drain BBO core executes its rings
4 Seal step StepRecord{kind: Seal, cut: C_f}
5 last block closed at S, signed (seq_sig)
a byzantine proposer cannot hold a healthy handoff
